text:
jessica: Support case #48291 from BetaApps — they want a burst quota increase (tokens) for a marketing push starting in ~2 hours. They say billing is on file but their traffic looks spiky. Can product and fraud triage?
jessica: Key details pasted from their support form: org_id=betaapps, current quota=25M tokens/day, requested=75M/day for 48h, expected peak RPS=900.
mike: @jessica thanks — sales spoke to them earlier, they'll sign an uplift if we can guarantee throughput. They want a provisional bump while legal finishes contract.
anita: Need quick signal on risk — any signs of abuse? Also what's our quick rollback plan if this kills capacity? :eyes:
tom: Eng-oncall here — if we lift hard limit we should put them on a dedicated throttling bucket and add automated fallback to smaller model & quota cap at 85M tokens. Can do config change from infra within 15m.
jessica: Fraud scan ran automatically, fraud-bot flagged unusual geo distribution and multiple new API keys: FRAUD_FLAG=geo-anom,multi-key. Not blocked but needs human review.
fraud-bot: Automated scan summary: high cross-region token issuance, 7 new API keys in past 12h, historical anomaly score=0.72. Recommend manual review before permanent increase.
anita: OK — proposal: provisional increase to 50M tokens/day for 24h, enable stricter rate caps (burst windows), and require BetaApps to provide expected IP ranges + signed usage policy. If fraud team clears, then extend to 75M for 48h and handoff to sales for committed capacity.
mike: Sounds reasonable. I'll notify the customer about provisional 24h uplift and request their IP list and expected query patterns. I'll also confirm payment method.
jessica: Action items: 1) @tom apply provisional config (50M/day, burst windows) — ticket created SUPPORT-48291-UPLIFT. 2) @fraud-bot/fraud-team manual review (link to case: https://internal.redwood/support/48291). 3) @mike collect IP ranges + billing auth. 4) @anita log decision and add to product backlog for dedicated capacity playbook.
tom: On it. Sample infra command I'm going to run:```influxctl quota set --org betaapps --tokens 50000000 --window 24h --reason "provisional uplift: marketing"```I'll push and post logs back here.
jessica: Note: we should mark this thread with label "provisional-uplift" and add a follow-up reminder in 22h to either extend or rollback.
anita: I'll create a quick product ticket (PROD-1298) to capture launch criteria & checklist so we don't ad-hoc these in future. Requirements: fraud clearance, IP allowlist, payment verification, rollout + rollback playbook.
fraud-bot: Manual review queue updated: case 48291 assigned to fraud-alyssa. ETA 40m for first pass.
mike: Customer notified: "We can provisionally increase tokens for 24 hours pending a short fraud review and confirmation of IPs/payment." They acknowledged and will send IP ranges within 30m. :thumbsup:
jessica: Closing loop — provisional increase applied, monitoring dashboards will alert if 95th pct RPS > 1k or error rate > 1%. If we see spikes we'll throttle and notify sales.
anita: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread after fraud clearance or earlier if any anomalies.
